title: Great Pyramid built over hundreds of years, not in Khufu's 23-year reign

tellings.quote: More likely it's a it's a project that took hundreds of years to complete uh

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza was not built during the 23-year reign of the pharaoh Khufu, as is usually said, but is 'more likely' a 'project that took hundreds of years to complete', according to the researcher Graham Hancock. He tells Michels this without naming a source, drawing on the ideas of the writer Robert Bauval. If true, the pyramid's story would start long before Khufu.
